reasons: Admitted on the vendor's own fetched documentation; this application has not run a live key gate against this endpoint.

admission.citation: https://dev.meta.ai/docs/models and https://dev.meta.ai/docs/pricing-rate-limits — Meta Model API documentation, retrieved 2026-09-25: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and Responses at `https://api.meta.ai/v1` with a Model API key; pay-as-you-go per-token billing; serves the Muse Spark models.

contextWindow.sourceRef: https://dev.meta.ai/docs/muse-ember (read 2026-11-24) — context window 1,048,576 tokens; https://dev.meta.ai/docs/models.md (read 2026-11-24): Muse Ember `muse-ember-1.0`

inputModalities.sourceRef: https://dev.meta.ai/docs/muse-ember (read 2026-11-24) — input text, image, video, audio and PDF; output text

toolCalling.sourceRef: https://dev.meta.ai/docs/muse-ember (read 2026-11-24) — "works with computer use, image understanding, tool calling, structured output, and search grounding"; API formats Responses, Chat Completions and Messages

parallelTools.sourceRef: https://dev.meta.ai/docs/tool-calling — parallel_tool_calls true by default in Chat and Responses; multiple tool calls may be returned

promptCaching.sourceRef: https://dev.meta.ai/docs/pricing-rate-limits — Muse Spark cached input has a separate price and prompt-prefix cache hits are documented

supported.sourceRef: https://dev.meta.ai/docs/muse-ember (read 2026-11-24) — reasoning effort from "minimal" to "max", default "max"

pricing.sourceRef: https://dev.meta.ai/docs/pricing-rate-limits.md (read 2026-11-24) — Muse Ember (`muse-ember-1.0`, Standard only): up to 200K input tokens $0.10 input / $0.004 cached input / $0.50 output per 1M; over 200K input tokens $0.30 / $0.012 / $1.50, and "A request over 200K input tokens is billed at the long-context rates for all of its tokens". Contributor mode is not offered for Muse Ember.
